name: Neutrino
description: Risk judgment layer for autonomous agents trading RWA and xStocks on Mantle. AI proposes, deterministic policy validates or overrides, and Mantle verifies the final decision with a keccak256 receipt.

services.description: Run a full policy loop for xStock and RWA scenarios. Returns AI proposal, policy review, final action, reasonHash, and a Mantle mainnet receipt.

skills.name: RWA Risk Evaluation
skills.description: Scores tokenized equities (NVDAx, TSLAx, SPYx) and yield-bearing RWAs (USDY, mETH) on market hours, spread, liquidity, basis, and volatility. Returns a deterministic risk score 0–1000 and a policy decision (ALLOCATE / PAUSE / REDUCE / MOVE_TO_STABLE_YIELD).

skills.name: On-Chain Decision Logging
skills.description: Commits every policy decision to Mantle mainnet via RWADecisionLogger.logDecision(). Each receipt includes action, riskScore, reasonHash = keccak256(canonicalJson), and policyHash. Immutable and verifiable on Mantlescan.

skills.name: Fluxion V3 Execution
skills.description: On ALLOCATE decisions, routes real USDC ↔ mETH swaps through Fluxion V3 SwapRouter (0x5628a59d…) on Mantle mainnet. Only executes on verified rails; capital never moves on an unconfirmed path.
